analysis: The only change in this PR is a documentation row added to docs/provider/cli-reference.md (head line ~2206) describing the watchdog crash-restart timing: the next check after an outage (1-2 min) and defaultGraceSeconds = 300 when continuing a crash-loop chain. The two units supplied (head lines 802-1729) are unchanged surrounding text; they cover the Autopilot, addon hold, sandbox setup/installer, stop/restart, status, doctor, models, benchmark and update CLI docs. The changed row itself falls outside the supplied line ranges. The patch excerpt shows it adds no code, controls, permissions or endpoints. It is relevant to T-043 (watchdog rollback authority) and T-046/T-047 only as a description of existing timing. The row cites WatchdogDecision.swift (WatchdogPolicy.graceSeconds), which I could not verify here. I found no weakened mitigation, no changed trust boundary and no invalidated assumption. The surrounding text on TB-012 add-on hold, TB-013 sandbox installer (TLS-only script verification, 0600 file, /bin/sh) and the prefix cache (T-041) matches the existing threat model and is unchanged by this PR. A reviewer may want to confirm the documented 300 s grace matches the source, but a doc inaccuracy is not a security regression. No findings.
